mapper.select: SELECT id, gmt_create, gmt_modify, file_hash, file_name, file_path, request_source, request_user_id, adviser_id, adviser_name, status, response_code, response_message, analysis_result, validation_result, comparison_data FROM b_contract_pdf_analysis_cache WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, gmt_create, gmt_modify, file_hash, file_name, file_path, request_source, request_user_id, adviser_id, adviser_name, status, response_code, response_message, analysis_result, validation_result, comparison_data FROM b_contract_pdf_analysis_cache ORDER BY gmt_create DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO b_contract_pdf_analysis_cache (gmt_create, gmt_modify, file_hash, file_name, request_source, request_user_id, status) VALUES (NOW(), NOW(), #{fileHash}, #{fileName}, #{requestSource}, #{requestUserId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE b_contract_pdf_analysis_cache SET gmt_modify = NOW(), status = #{status}, response_code = #{responseCode}, response_message = #{responseMessage}, analysis_result = #{analysisResult} WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE b_contract_pdf_analysis_cache SET gmt_modify = NOW(), file_path = #{filePath}, validation_result = #{validationResult}, comparison_data = #{comparisonData}, adviser_id = #{adviserId}, adviser_name = #{adviserName} WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash}
